name: filestrip
description: High-performance, zero-trust media sanitization suite & edge SDK. Runs deep binary telemetry purges (EXIF/GPS/serials/EOF), browser-native vision AI (explicit content & deepfakes), local WASM PII detection (IDs/cards/faces), and Cloudflare Worker edge enforcement.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: tsc --build packages/core packages/vision packages/sentinel packages/worker packages/sdk
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean packages/core packages/vision packages/sentinel packages/worker packages/sdk
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/core packages/vision packages/sentinel packages/worker packages/sdk
scripts.release:npm: npm run build:packages && npm publish --workspace=@filestrip/core --workspace=@filestrip/vision --workspace=@filestrip/sentinel --workspace=@filestrip/worker --workspace=@filestrip/sdk --access public
